title: Rewrite README audience scenarios
scope: Replace the unclear situation section in all maintained README languages with reader-first descriptions for individual developers, development teams, and enterprise organizations.
acceptance_criteria: The section heading states who Temple is for without framework jargon.
The three collapsible titles are concise audience labels: individual developer, development team, and enterprise organization in each language.
Each description starts from the reader's real problem and explains Temple's benefit before internal terminology.
Current validation and roadmap boundaries remain accurate.
English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese structures stay aligned and repository documentation checks pass.
